Notes: Bulk cap on switched 5V rail to GND. Spec: 100 uF, >=16 V, aluminium electrolytic, radial, <=10 mm dia, 5.0 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.

Coupling cap; blocks DC bias from Q1 emitter before RCA jack. 470µF not 100µF: into the 150Ω load (R5 75Ω + TV 75Ω) 100µF gives τ=15ms against the 16.7ms field period, which tilts the picture top-to-bottom. 470µF gives τ=70ms. Spec: 470 uF, >=16 V, aluminium electrolytic, radial, <=10 mm dia, 5.0 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.
X7R 16V+; U1 input decoupling - mount as close to U1 pin 1 as possible (TI datasheet requirement). Spec: 100 nF +/-10%, >=16 V, X7R, 0805 - any equivalent; the LCSC part above is a JLCPCB basic part.

VWM 5.80V / VBR 6.45-7.14V @10mA / VC 10.5V @143A. Cathode (banded end) toward +5V - the KiCad symbol names both pins A1/A2 and shows no polarity, but the footprint silkscreen has the band. Clamps above U1 absolute max 7V, so it protects the NES, not the eFuse

Non-polarized; backup protection upstream of U1 eFuse. KiCad footprint field mislabeled as polarized cap footprint in v1 (fix in v2). Footprint: no KiCad footprint exists for the Littelfuse RHEF series. F1 uses Fuse:Fuse_Bourns_MF-RG300 - pads 5.24 mm centre-to-centre, 1.01 mm drills. The RHEF200's 0.51 mm leads at 5.05 +/-0.75 mm spacing fit that, but the Bourns part is a 3.0 A/5.1 A device and the silkscreen outline is its body, not the RHEF200's - don't use it for clearance.

Description: RCA phono jack, right-angle PCB mount (audio)
Notes: Audio pass-through from J4 pin 2 - the board does not amplify audio. Sleeve to GND. Mouser 502-PJRAN1X1U03X. Red-bodied part; order the colour you want.

Description: RCA phono jack, right-angle PCB mount (video)
Notes: Composite video output, fed from C2 through R5. Sleeve to GND - see the v1 fault where this sleeve was wired to the audio net.

Description: Pin header 1x05, feed from the NES
Notes: Connection to the console: 1=video in, 2=audio in, 3=+5V out to the NES, 4/5=GND. Was missing from this BOM until 2026-08-28. Spec: 1x05 pin header, 2.54 mm, vertical THT. Suggested: LCSC C492404 (PZ254V-11-05P).

Feed to the panel-mounted 8-pin mini-DIN RGB connector: 1=video/sync, 2=GND, 3=+5V. Connector itself ships with the NESRGB kit and mounts in the shell. Spec: 1x03 pin header, 2.54 mm, vertical THT. Suggested: LCSC C2937625 (PZ254V-11-03P).

Flat side facing viewer, leads down = E-C-B left to right. Base=video in (through R2), Emitter=R1/C2 node, Collector=GND. 2SA1015 is obsolete and the market carries relabelled parts — source the KSA1015 (onsemi), same E-C-B pinout, still in production. Do not substitute 2N3906 or BC557 without re-checking the pinout; both differ.

Q1 emitter load: one end +5V, other end to Q1 emitter/C2 node. Not both ends to +5V. Raised from 300Ω for v2: at the assumed ~1.3V base, 300-330Ω supplies only ~6.2mA at peak white against the ~6.7mA the 150Ω load needs. 220Ω gives ~9.3mA and real headroom. Retune if the measured DC at J4.1 differs from ~1.3V. Spec: 220 ohm +/-5%, >=0.25 W, axial THT 7.62 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.

Series resistor between J4.1 (video in from NES) and Q1's base. Mirrors the 330Ω Nintendo places in the same position. Negligible signal loss against Q1's ~21kΩ base input impedance; limits fault current into the base-emitter junction, whose reverse rating is only 5V. New in v2. Spec: 330 ohm +/-5%, >=0.25 W, axial THT 7.62 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.
CC1 pulldown; measured 5.07kΩ. Spec: 5.1 kohm +/-5%, >=0.1 W, axial THT 7.62 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.
CC2 pulldown; measured 5.13kΩ. Spec: 5.1 kohm +/-5%, >=0.1 W, axial THT 7.62 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.
Video series termination; populated on the fabbed v1 board. Spec: 75 ohm +/-1%, >=0.25 W, axial THT 7.62 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.

Sets U1 current limit. I_OS = 25.9/R_ILIM(kohm) -> ~1.18A typ. Higher R = LOWER limit. Valid range 15k-232k. Spec: 22 kohm +/-1%, 0805 - keep the 1% tolerance, it sets the current limit. JLCPCB basic part.
Series source termination for the mini-DIN RGB connector video pin (mirrors R5 for the RCA jack). Spec: 75 ohm +/-1%, >=0.25 W, axial THT 7.62 mm pitch. No MPN - any equivalent.
Not a purchased part — bare plated holes for bring-up (video, GND, +5V, audio). Optionally fit 0.64mm square header pins for scope grabbers.
Adjustable OCP between F1 and the 5V rail. EN (pin 3) active-high tied to IN. Auto-retry version (the -1 suffix is latch-off). FAULT (pin 4) left unconnected

6-pin power-only (VBUS x2, GND x2, CC1, CC2); no data lines. Footprint: no KiCad USB4970 footprint exists. GCT's USB4970 drawing gives the same recommended land pattern as the USB4125 (pad centres 1.00/3.04/5.50 mm, shell holes 8.64 x 3.80 mm), verified 2026-08-28, so Connector_USB:USB_C_Receptacle_GCT_USB4125-xx-x is correct. Use the plain variant, not -0190: USB4970-00-A takes the 1.00 mm shell stake, -0190 is the 1.90 mm one.
